name: SEO Hacker Broken Link Scanner & Fixer
author: Alex H.

sections.description:
SEO Hacker Broken Link Scanner & Fixer is a next-generation link scanner built strictly for performance. Older link checkers are notorious for slowing down your frontend and overloading servers. We built SEO Hacker Broken Link Scanner & Fixer differently: it runs 100% asynchronously in the background, consuming zero frontend resources, while aggressively hunting down 404s, 500s, SSL errors, and timeouts.

Whether you’re fixing a handful of broken URLs on a personal blog or managing thousands of 301 redirects on a massive WooCommerce store, SEO Hacker Broken Link Scanner & Fixer gives you the tools to fix them all with a single click.

Native Page Builder Support
Unlike other scanners that only check standard WordPress content, our engine deeply integrates with Elementor, Gutenberg, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). We parse complex JSON data structures and serialized arrays to ensure every link on your site is checked.

In-Editor Live Fixing
Stop hunting for links! SEO Hacker Broken Link Scanner & Fixer adds a native sidebar to the Gutenberg Block Editor and a dedicated add-on panel directly inside the Elementor Editor. You can see and fix broken links instantly while you are writing or designing your pages, without ever leaving the editor.

Core Features

  • High-Performance Active Scanner: Scans posts, pages, custom post types, custom fields (meta), options, and comments without slowing down your site.
  • Passive Tracking: Automatically detects 404 errors encountered by real visitors in real-time.
  • Elementor & Gutenberg Editor Add-ons: Fix broken links live directly from inside the Elementor and Gutenberg editing screens.
  • Advanced URL Replacer Engine: Safely updates URLs even when deeply buried in Elementor JSON data or ACF serialized arrays.
  • Dedicated Redirects Manager: Clean up your 301, 302, and 307 redirects to pass full SEO link equity and improve page load speed.
  • Role-Based Access Control: Allow Authors and Editors to manage broken links exclusively within their own posts.
  • Scheduled Email Reports: Receive daily, weekly, or monthly summaries of your site’s link health, plus urgent alerts for critical outages.
  • Smart Exclusions: Ignore specific URLs or entire domains using wildcards or Regular Expressions (Regex).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/seo-hacker-broken-link-scanner-fixer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Link Fixer in the WordPress admin menu to run your first active scan.
  4. Open any page in Gutenberg or Elementor to try the in-editor live fixing panels!
sections.faq:
Does it slow down my website?

No! SEO Hacker Broken Link Scanner & Fixer was engineered specifically to avoid the performance issues of legacy link checkers. The scanner runs entirely in the backend using small, controlled AJAX batches. It does not load any scripts on the frontend of your website.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes, 100%. We have a specialized extraction engine that parses Elementor’s complex JSON data structures to find broken links. You can fix them via the central dashboard, or use our native Elementor Editor Addon to fix links while you build pages.

What HTTP status codes does it detect?

The scanner detects all relevant status codes including 404 (Not Found), 410 (Gone), 403 (Forbidden), 301/302/307/308 (Redirects), 500/503 (Server Errors), as well as Timeouts and SSL/Certificate errors.
